criteria.behavior: Chrome DevTools, Safari Apple Events and Cua browser drivers implement the shared contract with persistent sessions.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p7 after M1 adds that mode; inspect driver source, resource bundling, contract-review.md and session lifecycle evidence.
criteria.expected: Nonempty driver/decider suites pass; the reused projects and exact versions/licenses are recorded. Warm tasks do not create a new browser session per command.

criteria.behavior: DOM/AX reference identity, visibility, completeness and consent remain independent safety requirements.
criteria.check: Run p7 negative cases for wrong tab/origin, stale/detached nodes, off-screen content, injected page instructions, unknown dialog and changed navigation.
criteria.expected: No unintended input or automatic dialog approval. Enumeration is not treated as rendered proof; stale references cannot be reused.

criteria.behavior: Normal browser_task performs navigation, extraction and interaction, with fresh settle verification and generic pixel fallback.
criteria.check: Inspect .agent/results/P7/integration.json and public coordinator wiring; reproduce its controlled Chrome/Safari cases on the signed subject.
criteria.expected: Real executor results match independent DOM/native oracles. DOM failure can reach P5 pixels under the same scope; no per-site recipe is required.

criteria.behavior: Cancellation, navigation, layout changes and reconnects cannot duplicate or redirect an action.
criteria.check: Run p7 lifecycle tests and inspect integration records for interruption before/during/after mutation, ref rebinding and actual browser consent behavior.
criteria.expected: Known unsupported-before-input may fall back; uncertain mutations are verified or handed back. Real-profile attach avoids repeated Jev-triggered prompts and reports actual OS/browser limits.

criteria.behavior: The frozen signed browser slice meets success, latency and matched pixel-path speed requirements.
criteria.check: Run SHIP-PLAN's desktop-lock command with tag p7; inspect qualification.json, all raw browser/pixel rows, oracles and signed manifest.
criteria.expected: Strict success >=90%, p50 <=15s, >=2x faster than the matched Sol-pixel path, PROGRAM repetitions/Wilson bar and zero false Done. New goal gaps, p95 and network/cold totals remain visible.

criteria.behavior: The browser phase has an authorized independent PASS and reproducible handoff.
criteria.check: Inspect source/final verdict, integrated lane result, source/runtime evidence bindings, real-profile human checklist and phase handoff.
criteria.expected: No unresolved finding or hidden qualification gap; owned sessions/tabs and permission/setup requirements are documented.
